description:
The Asmaraty G-100 is a brand-new 100ft (30.5 m) super yacht built in the United Arab Emirates, with three decks of living space and a 7 m beam. We visited her at the Qatar Boat Show 2026 and obtained an exclusive price with an exceptional promotion, available through Yacht Research.

The main deck opens into a bright saloon and a formal dining area, surrounded by lounge seating and bathed in natural light by the broad side windows. Forward, the wheelhouse has a modern glass-cockpit helm. Outside, the aft deck and the generous flybridge offer outdoor dining, sunbeds, a bar, a second helm station and space for an optional hot tub: ideal for sunset cruises and entertaining.

Below deck, five guest cabins sleep up to twelve guests: a full-beam owner's suite with en-suite bathroom and walk-in wardrobe, a forward VIP cabin with plenty of storage, and guest cabins with twin berths along the sides. Crew quarters for five, with their own galley area and bathroom, keep the crew separate from the guests.

Power comes from twin 1,600 hp MTU engines coupled to ZF gearboxes, with twin 50 kVA generators, a 24-ton chilled water air conditioning system and a fuel capacity of almost 11,000 litres for extended cruising. A hydraulic swim platform is available as an option.

Contact Yacht Research for the full specification, the list of options, delivery timing and a private viewing.
